events.outcome: H2O PayGo overseas continuity remains conflicted. A 2024 community recommendation reports PayGo Wi-Fi Calling and activation outside the United States, while the current PrepaidCompare profile says Wi-Fi Calling is monthly-plan only and a 2026 China-use guide reports recurring support resets may be needed. Current H2O terms still frame service as personal use in the U.S. only. Preserve HOLD and do not claim stable overseas SMS/OTP continuity.

keep.action: Recharge before the PAYG expiration date to roll eligible balance forward. The $10 and $30 options expire after 90 days; $100 expires after 365 days. A zero balance for 30 consecutive days can cancel the account and number.

data.holdReason: Current terms exclude PAYG from International Roaming, and PAYG-specific Wi-Fi Calling/China continuity is not verified. Keep as observation/HOLD rather than recommending it for overseas number retention.
